description: This file defines a PHP class 'CustomerReward' within the OpenCart admin extension for report controllers. It handles various functionalities related to customer reward reports, including viewing, listing, and saving report settings.

classes.name: CustomerReward
classes.description: Controller class responsible for managing the customer reward report in the OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the reward customer report form page.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Displays the customer reward report page.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns the reward customer report list in output.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Generates and returns the report data as a string, applying any filters from request parameters.
